source_register.title: The Maine Genealogist 47(4), 2025, Flanagan and Reeves, pp.170–182

source_register.title: General Putnam's Report and Description (1786), original paper record
source_register.type: archival original requested; related survey link only

source_register.title: Maine State Archives Fox Islands survey plan, 1785
source_register.detail: Stone/Mathews survey, attested Putnam; land outlines, not individually named Beveridge allotments.

source_register.title: Wheeler & Wheeler, History of Brunswick, Topsham, and Harpswell, 1878
source_register.detail: Original full digitized 1878 volume. Printed page ~41 plan index includes Topsham Samuel Beveridge #3 and Brunswick 'Beverage' #25; printed page ~836 family histories reports James Henry's son James probably married Mercy Beveridge Feb 15, 1776.

source_register.title: Topsham early settler table based on 1878 Wheeler history
source_register.detail: Lists James Beveridge, 1758, lot 7 and Samuel Beveridge, 1752, lot 3. No deed image or evidence of how the individuals relate.

source_register.title: Wheeler 1878, 18th-century labeled map key
source_register.type: digitized text of 1878 printed map list
source_register.detail: Lists numbered place 3 under Topsham as Samuel Beveridge and 25 under Brunswick as Beverage; locations need inspection on original map image and dating of the plan.

source_register.title: Wheeler 1878 family history of James Henry (printed p.836)
source_register.detail: States son James of the elder James Henry 'probably' married Mercy Beveridge Feb 15, 1776. Not proof by itself for Mercy's parentage or identity.

source_register.title: Hope county-jurisdiction chronology
source_register.detail: Hope within Lincoln County before 1827, Waldo County 1827-1860, Knox County beginning 1860. Search for 1830s Matthew estate under Waldo, not Knox.

source_register.title: Waldo County Registry of Deeds
source_register.detail: Official page says indexed land records and plans from 1700s onward are available through statewide search portal; whether a particular early instrument is digitized still needs confirmation.

source_register.title: Lincoln County probate abstracts 1760–1800
source_register.detail: Contains early Lincoln County probate abstracts with original records accessible via FamilySearch; search James Beveridge and surname variants. Absence from secondary index does not prove absence of an estate.

source_register.title: Maine County Probate Records, 1760–1979
source_register.detail: Browsable by county; earlier Waldo County books are candidate location for 1830s Hope estates. Not evidence a Matthew entry exists.

source_register.title: Massachusetts Archives Eastern Lands papers finding aid
source_register.detail: Early Maine land grants, committee deeds, reports, petitions and disputes; useful for 1785 petition and land allotment research.

source_register.title: Massachusetts Archives family research guide
source_register.detail: Explains where pre-statehood Maine petitions, land committees and legislative records survive.

cases.person_or_place: Matthew Beveridge (minor) / Capt. Matthew Beverage of Hope
cases.question: Prove whether the named 1785 minor and the 1865 Capt. Matthew of Hope are the same individual and whether James Beveridge/Jean White were his parents.
cases.action: Search Waldo County probate and index (approx. 1827–1860), earlier Lincoln County if death before 1827; review Hope and Fox Islands vital records and name-variant deeds; do not create children/parents in the family tree until identified.
cases.expected_evidence: Estate settlement, baptism, marriage, guardianship, land grant or independently dated family register.

cases.person_or_place: Fox Islands settlers' stated arrival years
cases.current_status: Specific archival box identified; source itself not retrieved
cases.question: What did James, Thomas and Matthew Beveridge individually report as settlement dates and residency?
cases.action: Request scan/transcript of General Putnam report dated March 18, 1786 in Box 001; separately seek June 1785 petition original (incl names, guardianship and handwriting) and correlate 1785 survey plans.
cases.expected_evidence: Contemporary arrival/claim statements, lot references, attachments.
cases.certainty: Original referenced in scholarly study, not examined

cases.person_or_place: James and Samuel Beveridge at Topsham / Brunswick 1750s
cases.current_status: Published map key and settlers' index, no deed confirmation
cases.question: Who was Samuel Beveridge on Topsham Lot 3 by 1752? Is he related to James Sr., James Jr. or another lineage, and what is the 1758 James lot 7 deed?
cases.action: Examine printed Wheeler map page and original grant books, then trace deeds 1752/1758 (Topsham then Lincoln County) and probate / military and church sources. Cross-check the site's existing Samuel b.1702 candidate rather than attaching the lot automatically.
cases.expected_evidence: Original deeds with grantee, grantor, witnesses, lot bounds, spouses and subsequent transfers.

cases.person_or_place: Mercy Beveridge and James Henry marriage
cases.current_status: A 1878 history calls 15 Feb 1776 marriage probable
cases.question: Is the site's Mercy Beveridge Henry (b. 1753) the Mercy reported as marrying James, son of James Henry, in February 1776?
cases.action: Search Topsham church and marriage returns, original 1776 vital register, Maine 1800 census and Henry family probate; maintain site's existing spouse field unchanged until resolved.
cases.expected_evidence: Marriage register, family Bible, probate or deed describing spousal name and father.
cases.certainty: Published as probably, not a confirmed marriage

cases.person_or_place: Pulpit Harbor Beveridge farm ownership and bridge chains
cases.current_status: Historic locations known; parcel chain missing
cases.question: Which original allotments became later Pulpit Harbor farms, mill sites and Beach Bridge holdings, and what acreage was transferred?
cases.action: Search Waldo/Knoх deed indexes by all Beverage spellings and counterparties, work backward from 1917 farm deed and 1883 Beach Bridge to earliest identified lots; ground all boundaries in deed calls and survey control points.
cases.expected_evidence: Book/page, metes-and-bounds, grantor/grantee, acreage if stated, survey tie points.

cases.person_or_place: James Beveridge Sr. and Scottish ancestry
cases.current_status: Claimed Scottish origin, no town/parish or parent established
cases.question: What documented Maine record identifies James Sr.'s birthplace, immigration or parentage?
cases.action: Seek earliest original military paylists at Fort Richmond, Kennebec deeds, church/marriage/probate records, and only then select Scottish parish candidates; do not link any similarly named Scottish family without transatlantic proof.
cases.expected_evidence: Identifying birth parish, relatives, occupation, immigration or settlement context contemporaneously recorded.
